## 1. Purpose / Scope

This Solution Cost Input captures the infrastructure and hosting requirements for the Missouri Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) modernization. The project replaces a legacy mainframe claims processing system with a cloud-native platform on AWS GovCloud, serving 1.2 million Medicaid members and 45,000 providers across the state.

Key concerns addressed:

- Define AWS GovCloud hosting with single-tenant isolation for MARS-E compliance
- Identify scalability for 1.2M members with 15M claims/month peak processing
- Specify EKS-based compute with PostgreSQL and Redis data tier
- Document Active-Passive DR with 4-hour RTO / 15-minute RPO
- Capture Direct Connect networking at 2x10 Gbps to state data center
- Identify 18TB data migration from legacy DB2 mainframe
- Detail 4 environments (CFG, SIT, UAT, PRD) each in dedicated AWS accounts

page_texts.14:
[resources/work-templates/assets/sales/examples/scr-good-example.md#tenancy-model]

### Tenancy Model

**Selected:** Single-tenant

Justification: MARS-E 2.0 compliance requires dedicated compute and data isolation. Missouri DSS contract mandates no shared infrastructure with other state programs. PHI/FTI data classification prohibits multi-tenant data stores.
page_texts.15:
[resources/work-templates/assets/sales/examples/scr-good-example.md#managed-services-preference]

### Managed Services Preference

**Selected:** Mix of both

Details: Managed Kubernetes (EKS) and managed databases (RDS PostgreSQL) preferred for operational efficiency. Self-hosted Redis cluster for claims caching due to low-latency requirements (<5ms p99). S3 for document storage (managed).

### Environment Requirements & Scheduling

Each environment is deployed in its own dedicated AWS account with full resource isolation (ECR, Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, IAM, S3, KMS per account).

| Environment | Required | Size (% of Prod) | Availability | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Configuration (CFG)** | Yes | 10% | On-demand | Terraform/IaC validation only |
| **System Integration Testing (SIT)** | Yes | 50% | Business hours (M-F 7am-7pm CT) | State QA team read access; auto-shutdown nights/weekends |
| **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** | Yes | 75% | Business hours (M-F 7am-7pm CT) | State UAT team full access; production-like masked data |
| **Production (PRD)** | Yes | 100% | 24x7x365 | 99.95% SLA; Reserved Instances (3yr) |

[resources/work-templates/assets/sales/examples/scr-good-example.md#availability-target]

### Availability Target

**Selected:** 99.95% (~4.38 hours downtime/year) — Multi-AZ with failover

Justification: Missouri DSS SLA requires 99.95% for claims processing during business hours. Multi-AZ deployment provides AZ-level failover without the cost of multi-region active-active.

| **Recovery Time Objective (RTO)** | 4 hours |
| **Recovery Point Objective (RPO)** | 15 minutes |

### Data Classification

**Selected:** PII, PHI, FTI

The system processes Protected Health Information (member medical claims), Personally Identifiable Information (member demographics, SSNs), and Federal Tax Information (provider TINs for 1099 reporting).
page_texts.27:
[resources/work-templates/assets/sales/examples/scr-good-example.md#regulatory-compliance]

### Regulatory Compliance

**Selected:** HIPAA, MARS-E, NIST 800-53 v5 (Moderate)

Missouri DSS requires MARS-E 2.0 compliance for all Medicaid systems. NIST 800-53 r5 Moderate baseline applies. FedRAMP not required (GovCloud satisfies state requirements).
